title: ◊Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site
caption: •Tatooine: City Outskirts (V)
game_text: Your starfighters may deploy here (for -1 Force), and take off and land here for free. Incom Corporation and Koensayr Manufacturing may deploy here.
dark_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Dantooine, Endor, Hoth, or Subjugated Planet. Rebel Cell sites are immune to Revolution and No Escape. Limit one copy on table.

notes: Group: Rebel Cell. FULL portrait site overlay printed sideways that RENAMES the site: both bars read '◊ REBEL CELL - HIDDEN LANDING SITE' (hollow diamond ◊ = non-unique; red outline on the Light bar, white on the Dark bar). Art window blank. Light half (right bar) = game_text, Dark half (left bar, black text box) = dark_text. Force slots: Light bar TWO blue sabers (light_force_count 2, as the printed card's Light Force ×2), Dark bar one red saber. Icon boxes both bars, outermost first: planet (pink planet), exterior (sky with suns); no scomp ring (printed card has none either). Bottom margin: VS15 set sphere only (gold disc with figure = the cover set symbol) → icons []; the printed card's Tatooine expansion ring + Episode I icon (right margin) are not shown on the slip. Caption '•Tatooine: City Outskirts (V)' names the base card. CHANGES vs printed Tatooine: City Outskirts (Tatooine, unique •, Light 'Once per game, may deploy a Jedi here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.' / Dark 'Maul moves to here for free when using his landspeed.'): renamed ◊ (non-unique), both texts replaced; Force icons and planet/exterior boxes unchanged. Slip text matches the wiki stub (stub concatenates both halves). Base scan 490×350 only (res.starwarsccg.org); copyright Tatooine 2001 SE-style line read off the scan. Modern: VB4-L-rebelcellhiddenlandingsite-pre.gif (Virtual Block 4 reissue; it prints a later errata text, 103E — art only).
